request: Learn a 20–30 cm straight physical wheel approach after local grasp passed 20/20 new poses and 14/14 retention.
teacher_training: 25 independent r1/r3 distance pairs on the 20, 22.5, 25, 27.5, 30 cm grid; fixed scene, seed 11.
development_pilot: 20/20 cm, 30/30 cm, 20/30 cm; all are training conditions. Do not tune using the sealed 20-case rollout.
heldout: 20 predeclared new continuous distances: 10 symmetric and 10 independent asymmetric pairs. Same scene; no new object, heading, or layout.
runtime_inputs: Own RGB, fixed top RGB, own issued commands and controller history. No GT, IK, contact, or measured velocity in transitions.
physical_boundary: Only initial fixture placement may write base pose. Folded setup precedes raw wheel motion. No post-approach pose writes or GT alignment. Two fresh images after fixed stop dwells authorize initialization replay sequence 1 onward and the existing grasp.
camera: Preserve current own/top camera placement, field of view, and image resolution.

nominal_budget.confirmation_behavior: After both robots propose stop, apply 0.25 s zero-wheel dwell, capture confirmation 1, apply another 0.25 s zero-wheel dwell, then capture confirmation 2. Both fresh stationary predictions must authorize stop. Failed confirmation aborts without blind forward motion.

baseline: Constant forward command 0.1 with duration calibrated from 25 cm training evidence before heldout. One duration for every test distance; no GT stop feedback.
scope: Learned straight approach and local RGB correction. Arm deployment, close, and lift remain explicit playback. This is not general navigation, LLM collaboration, or hardware validation.
storage: Commit source before collection and freeze each cohort. Keep all results, including failures and exclusions, with source and raw file hashes. Raw video is local unless explicitly archived.
teacher_controller: Outside the 4 mm stop band and before the target: forward = min(0.15, max(0.01, 0.2 * remaining_m)); otherwise zero. Gain was reduced after momentum overshoot, then a minimum moving command was added after small commands stalled 12.4–12.9 mm before target. Only three development teacher cases were used; no heldout rollout was run.

development_history.finding: 0.8 proportional gain and .2 s observations led to momentum overshoot; retained all failed evidence.
Gain0.2 avoided overshoot but commands around0.0025 left12.4–12.9mm distance after20s; add minimum moving forward0.01 before target.
